plugins.name: devplan
plugins.description: Product intelligence for software teams, powered by your Devplan workspace. Four dashboards refreshed twice every weekday: a Daily Radar tailored to you, Execution Monitoring with slipped work and a searchable changelog, a Demand Report with customer promises, market moves and suggested projects, and Engineering Analytics. Plan cycles from your team's real pace, and write specs that are tracked in Devplan automatically. Requires a Devplan account; setup walks you through creating one.
